_comment: NonParallel merch, from Bryton's 2024 NP merch spec: a small logo in the middle of the chest, the large logo in the middle of the back, sold for $25 at most. S–XL are $25; 2XL and 3XL cost more to make, so they step up $3 each and carry a little more margin to help the base sizes. Each product is one design on the tee colors in `colors`. `design.uploadId` is an image already in Printify's uploads; `design.url` is a public PNG that Printify fetches once (found again by `fileName` after that). `placements` are Printify print-area coordinates (x, y = centre, scale = width relative to the print area). Prices are in cents and include US shipping. Edit and push: the Printify workflow creates/updates the products and commits lib/merch-catalog.json plus the mockups.
details: Small logo on the chest, the full design across the back
100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (solid colors)
Lightweight 4.2 oz jersey: soft and breathable
Unisex retail fit with a ribbed crew neck
